duplicate_cleaning.description: Import-time remove_duplicate_items scans config `items` for two entries sharing an `id`, deletes the earlier entry, and repeats until no duplicates remain; the later duplicate is kept. The stored census counts above are pre-cleaning values: the stored file itself contains no duplicate item ids (778 of 778 distinct), so the cleaner is a no-op on current sources. Served configuration therefore matches stored counts for `items` before patches are considered.

dynamic_derivation.description: make_dynamic rewrites every darts_items `start_date` from the wall clock: it runs once at import (get_game_config.py:319) and again on every served response inside get_game_config (get_game_config.py:89-91), via update_darts week-wrapping. Served `start_date` bytes are therefore time-dependent and nondeterministic across runs. The census records stored sources only; served-byte equality is explicitly unverified and out of scope.

mods.status: inactive: mods/mods.txt ships with its single mod `no_hiring_needed` commented out, so modify_game_config applies nothing at load time. The archived mod payload mods/no_hiring_needed.json is preserved but never loaded.

policy.count_note: Entry counts are stored-source values from config/main.json before patch application, duplicate cleaning, and dynamic derivation. The approved proposal listed the same 20 top-level keys and 5 ordered patches; this census records source truth as verified by tools/content-census/verify_content.py.
policy.evidence_policy: File inspection only. This census is evidence of reviewed stored sources, not evidence of served-byte equality, content validity, gameplay parity, or normalization. Served darts start_date bytes are time-dependent and explicitly unverified.
policy.served_bytes_note: Served configuration is re-derived from the wall clock by make_dynamic at import (get_game_config.py:319) and on every served response (get_game_config.py:89-91); census coverage is stored sources only.
